question: What is the meaning of building physics in relation to physical?
description: Building physics in relation to physical refers to the study and understanding of the physical properties and behavior of buildings and construction materials. It involves aspects such as energy performance, heat transfer, thermal properties, sound insulation, fire protection, ventilation, and air tightness. Building physics aims to optimize the performance and efficiency of buildings by considering how different physical factors interact within the built environment.
